title: Hard Flags Quiz: 20 Look-Alike Flags
description: A hard flag quiz with look-alikes: Australia vs New Zealand, Chad vs Romania, Norway vs Iceland and more. Can you tell them apart?
h1: Hard Flags Quiz: Can You Tell the Twins Apart?
intro: Some flags look so alike that even seasoned travelers hesitate. This hard flags quiz is built around those look-alikes: Australia and New Zealand, Norway and Iceland, Mali and Guinea, Colombia and Ecuador, and many more. Across 20 questions, you will see one flag at a time and have to choose the right country from four tempting options, often including its near twin. The first questions are on the easier side, while the final ones feature rarely seen flags, so only careful observers will make it through. You get about five seconds per question. Each answer comes with a short explanation that spells out the difference. Good luck.

faq: Which flags are the most commonly confused?

The most commonly confused pairs are Australia and New Zealand, Romania and Chad, Indonesia and Monaco, Norway and Iceland, and Colombia and Ecuador. The key is often a tiny detail, such as a star count, a stripe order or a shade of blue.
What is the best way to tell similar flags apart?

Learn one distinguishing feature for each pair, such as the number of stars, the direction of stripes, the order of colors or the presence of an emblem. Then practice with quizzes like this one, which explain the difference after each answer.
Are Indonesia and Monaco flags identical?

They are very similar. Both flags are red over white. The main difference is their proportions: Indonesia's is 2:3 while Monaco's is 4:5, which makes it slightly squarer. Poland's flag is the reverse, with white over red. Because of this, the two flags are often confused, and the difference matters mainly in official contexts and sporting events.
